title: International Higher Diploma In Information Technology (Level 3)
description: Enhance your technical expertise and problem-solving skills with the International Foundation Diploma in Information Technology (Level 3).
longDescription: This course provides a comprehensive understanding of core information technology principles, including computer systems, coding and website development, and network management. Students will develop essential skills in mobile communications, cybersecurity, and leveraging social media for business, preparing them for diverse challenges in the tech industry. After the successful completion of the Programme, you will earn a UK 60 credit hours Certification awarded by GSS partners.
courseDetails: The International Foundation Diploma in Information Technology (Level 3) covers critical subjects such as computer systems, coding and website development, and network management. Students will explore mobile communications, cybersecurity, and the use of social media for business. Emphasis is placed on practical applications of IT theories through hands-on projects and real-world case studies. Graduates will be well-equipped to pursue careers in various tech sectors or further their studies in IT-related fields.
courseDetailParagraphs: The International Foundation Diploma in Information Technology (Level 3) covers critical subjects such as computer systems, coding and website development, and network management. Students will explore mobile communications, cybersecurity, and the use of social media for business. Graduates will be well-equipped to pursue careers in various tech sectors or further their studies in IT-related fields.
entry: To enrol in this International Foundation Diploma In Information Technology (Level-3), learners must possess:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Results can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Results. (This is assessed on a case-by-case basis).
* Learner must be 18 years and older at the start of the Course.
Mature Learners (21 years and older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership or management roles. (This is assessed on a case-by-case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
progression: Upon completing the International Foundation Diploma In Information Technology (Level-3) students become eligible to pursue advanced studies, including admission into a Bachelor's degree. This qualification opens doors to various programs, allowing students to specialize further in areas such as software development, cybersecurity, or network administration.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors. Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak to our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
gettingStartedIntro: Complete the application, document review, offer, payment and enrolment steps through the learner portal.
certificateDetails: You will receive a degree from GSS Partner Universities.

modules.title: Level 3-Computer Systems
modules.summary: This module introduces students to the fundamental concepts of computer systems, focusing on hardware, software, networking, and system maintenance. Students will explore how computer systems operate, their components, and the basics of troubleshooting and security. The module also emphasizes practical skills needed for setting up, managing, and maintaining computer systems effectively. By the end of this module, students will gain essential knowledge and hands-on experience to understand and support computer systems in various environments.

lessons.title: Unit 1 Introduction to Computer Systems
Unit 2 Hardware Components and System Assembly
Unit 3 Operating Systems and Software Applications
Unit 4 Networking Basics and System Security
Unit 1 Fundamentals of Coding and Programming
Unit 2 Introduction to Web Design and Development
Unit 3 Building Responsive Websites
Unit 4 Debugging and Optimizing Web Applications

modules.title: Level 3- Networks
modules.summary: This module introduces students to the fundamental concepts and technologies of computer networks. It covers the principles behind network design, protocols, and infrastructure, equipping students with the knowledge required to understand how networks operate in both small and large-scale environments. The module also explores security aspects and troubleshooting techniques essential for maintaining and optimizing network systems.

lessons.title: Unit 1 Introduction to Networking and Network Models
Unit 2 Types of Networks and Network Topologies
Unit 3 Network Protocols and Communication Standards
Unit 4 Network Security and Troubleshooting

modules.title: Level 3-Mobile Communications
modules.summary: This module provides students with an in-depth understanding of mobile communication systems and their underlying technologies. It covers the evolution of mobile networks, from 2G to 5G, and explores the architecture of mobile networks, mobile device operation, and emerging mobile technologies. Students will also learn about the key challenges and innovations shaping the future of mobile communications.

lessons.title: Unit 1 Introduction to Mobile Communications and Technologies
Unit 2 Mobile Network Architecture and Evolution
Unit 3 Mobile Devices and Operating Systems
Unit 4 Mobile Communication Security and Emerging Trends

modules.title: Level 3-Cyber Security
modules.summary: This module provides students with a comprehensive understanding of the principles and practices of cyber security. Students will explore key concepts such as risk management, threat analysis, and data protection, as well as the latest trends in securing digital environments. The module will also cover various security measures, policies, and techniques used to safeguard information systems in a rapidly evolving digital landscape.

lessons.title: Unit 1 Introduction to Cyber Security Principles
Unit 2 Threats, Vulnerabilities, and Risk Management in Cyber Security
Unit 3 Data Protection, Encryption, and Privacy
Unit 4 Ethical Hacking and Penetration Testing

modules.title: Level 3-Social Media For Business
modules.summary: This module focuses on the strategic use of social media platforms in the business environment. Students will learn how social media can enhance brand visibility, engage customers, and drive business growth. Emphasis is placed on content creation, analytics, and the ethical considerations of using social media for business purposes.

lessons.title: Unit 1 Introduction to Social Media in Business
Unit 2 Building a Social Media Strategy
Unit 3 Content Creation and Engagement on Social Media
Unit 4 Analyzing Social Media Metrics and Performance
